body:
Remember that, when the target type is known, you should be able to simplify the type like:


```
	ERR_FAIL_INDEX_V(p_terrain_set, tile_set->get_terrain_sets_count(), (HashMap()));
```

If you're feeling fancy, you can even use the `{}` syntax:

```
	ERR_FAIL_INDEX_V(p_terrain_set, tile_set->get_terrain_sets_count(), {});
```

Whether this is an improvement is perspective I think, so I'm not sure if I'm suggesting you should change it. I prefer non repetition, but I'll leave it up to you.

Good points to consider for sure! To me `HashMap()` looks a bit odd because I don't expect to see generic types without the generics, and `{}` looks bare on its own. I can change it if there is consensus from core, but subjectively I like the PR as it is... though it's a slight preference, I don't mind either way.
No need to bring this to Core. This is just a matter of preference, if you prefer it the way it is, that's fine by me.
